journey.name: Payment Review Refresh Deferral
journey.description: Verifies that a Bitcoin Payment Request remains usable while reviewing and authorizing it, and that closing or backgrounding review does not prevent later requests from arriving. Requires two linked disposable regtest wallets, an existing PIN with payment-PIN enabled and biometric authorization disabled, and at least 10,000 sats in Savings. Use only authorized regtest payments. On iOS, app lock removes the send view; unlocking must restore the unpaid review without dismissing and reopening it. The final iOS app-lock checks also require a linked issuer capable of fixed conversion terms and current local USDT and Bitcoin endpoints; no USDT funding or payment is required. Report those checks as blocked if that issuer is unavailable. Queue-admission and expiry fault checks are covered separately by repository tests; this journey verifies the visible flow without changing payment terms.

actions.action: On the requester, send the payer an on-chain-only Bitcoin Payment Request for 1,000 sats
On the payer, verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") shows 1,000 sats and Savings is selected
Leave the confirmation open for 30 seconds
Verify the amount remains 1,000 sats and payment authorization has not started
On the requester, send the payer a second on-chain-only Bitcoin Payment Request for 2,000 sats
Verify the first confirmation still shows 1,000 sats and is not replaced by the second request
Swipe to pay using the control with id "GRAB", complete any sending-warning confirmation, and wait on PIN entry for 30 seconds without authorizing
Cancel PIN entry, then close the send sheet without paying
Verify Activity contains no outgoing payment for this request
Leave the payer unlocked and in the foreground while ordinary Payment Request synchronization resumes; do not require the next request to arrive immediately when review closes
On the payer, verify the second request becomes visible without restarting the app
Close the second request without paying, then reopen the first request from the pending-request list
Verify the confirmation still shows the original 1,000 sats
Background the app, reopen it, and complete app-unlock PIN entry

Without dismissing or reopening the send sheet, verify the original confirmation shows 1,000 sats and the fee, the swipe control with id "GRAB" is ready, and Show Details with id "SendConfirmToggleDetails" opens the details
Close details, swipe to pay, and complete PIN authorization
Verify the success screen (id "SendSuccess") is visible
Close success and verify Activity contains exactly one outgoing payment for the original request
On the requester, verify the original request records the completed Bitcoin payment without another payment from the payer
Verify the second request remains unpaid

For the iOS app-lock check, have the linked issuer send a new one-time request for amount "1", asset "usd", accepted identifiers "btc-regtest-p2wpkh" and "usdt-arbitrum-address", and fixed conversion rates "btc" equal to "0.00001" and "usdt" equal to "1"
Wait for the Amount screen (id "SendAmount"), select Savings through the asset selector if needed, and verify the Bitcoin amount is 1,000 sats
Tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount"), verify Bitcoin confirmation (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") shows 1,000 sats, and wait for fee preparation to finish

Background the app, reopen it, and complete app-unlock PIN entry; verify the same Bitcoin confirmation returns with 1,000 sats, a prepared fee, and the swipe control ready without reopening or selecting the asset again
Swipe to pay, complete any sending-warning confirmation, and stop on payment PIN entry without authorizing; background the app, reopen it, and complete only app-unlock PIN entry

Verify the unpaid Bitcoin confirmation returns with the same amount and requires a new swipe and payment authorization; close it without paying and verify Activity contains no outgoing payment for this request
